title: The Milky Way and an aurora in one sky
description:
Astronomers say the Sun links the two. It is a star of the Milky Way, and it sends out the particles that make aurora.
NASA picture: JSC, iss074e0491096. NASA/Chris Williams, 17 Apr 2026.
Every day’s picture: https://cosmos.rimilab.com/
Today’s APOD photo is by Guillaume Scheib: https://science.nasa.gov/image-article/apod-2026-november-17-milky-way-versus-aurora/. To use it, please ask the owner.
